description: Submit signed evidence to an open dispute before its evidence deadline. Claimant evidence must be signed by the payer key; respondent evidence additionally requires the seller API key (the Tersign plugin's settings in Claude Code, or the TERSIGN_* environment variables). Each artifact is sent as its digest and kind, plus its time and note when given; its content never leaves your side. Triage (adjudicate_dispute) uses only whether each side filed, never the content, kind or note of what was filed; the evidence stays on the record for the parties and any external venue. It moves no money. Each party's first item on a dispute always fits the room reserved for it when the dispute opened; a later item is refused (HTTP 503) while the ledger's dispute capacity is full.

artifacts.description: at least one evidence reference; submit every artifact you want on the record in a single call

at.description: unix seconds the artifact was produced; supply it when timing is part of your argument

digest.description: 0x-prefixed keccak256 digest of the artifact. Only the DIGEST is submitted — the content itself never leaves your side

kind.description: what this artifact is; recorded for the parties and any external venue — the triage rules do not read it

note.description: short human-readable label for whoever reads the record; never an input to the triage rules

disputeDigest.description: 0x-prefixed digest of the open dispute, as returned by open_dispute

role.description: which side you are filing as: 'claimant' = the payer who opened it (payer key) · 'respondent' = the seller answering it (also needs the seller API key)

name: submit_dispute_evidence
title: Submit dispute evidence
